deviations: Reduced sizes (decided before any run finished, at the project owner's request): PaperQA2 and STORM on the first 10 entries of the seeded order instead of 24; GraphRAG within 1,000 model calls (floor 6 entries) instead of 3,000 (floor 12). Every result here is exploratory.

PaperQA2 was run without its agent: `Docs.aadd` per paper and `Docs.aquery` per question (the README's 'Manual (No Agent)' usage) instead of the default `agent_query` (`pqa ask`). The default agent selects tools by function calling, and the 'fake' agent ends with a function-calling Complete step; the adapter in front of the project's command-line model cannot serve tool calls. Retrieval, contextual summaries and the answer step are PaperQA2's own; the agent's iterative search and its decision to stop are not exercised.

Embedding cut and re-run: the shared local embedder (bge-small-en-v1.5) truncates at 512 tokens, so the first PaperQA2 run (`paperqa`) embedded only the first ~510 tokens of each ~5,000-character chunk. PaperQA2 was re-run with whole-chunk embeddings (windows of 510 tokens averaged; `paperqa_pooled`), which is reported as the main result; the first run is kept as a sensitivity result. Requests identical between the two runs were served from the cache in the second, so its fresh calls understate what a stand-alone run costs (calls here count every distinct request once, wherever it was first made).

GraphRAG on 4 entries (621313, 615582, 616326, 620029), below the design's floor of 6: the fixed in-order rule stopped when the fifth entry (611521) did not fit in what was left of the 1,000-call cap (the operator's projection; the tally in the ledgers is 698 calls, including the global-search queries and a smoke test).

GraphRAG global search was added on the same 4 indexes (the CLI default is local search, which is the main GraphRAG result). Its citations name community reports only; a report is mapped to the papers of the text units its community's entities came from, a looser mapping than PaperQA2's (named papers) or local search's (text units, entities, relationships; a block's papers are the union over every record it cites, counting only records the query showed the model).

STORM did not complete any entry: the model's safety filter stopped every chain-of-thought prompt of its research stage (30 of 30 fresh requests stopped; the 20 plain outline prompts were answered), so no article was produced. Per the rules, nothing was retried or reworded. STORM is reported as completion 0 of 10.

The comparison strategies' drafts (run omim100) are the published drafts, after their one audit-and-repair round; the systems' drafts had none. The design treats every arm alike without repair; the repair round moved coverage by about 0.2 points in the hidden-full-text experiment, so this favours the comparison strategies very slightly at most. Their (a) and (c) come from stored marks; (b) from stored whole-draft marks where present, otherwise scored here once (the same path).

Bookkeeping corrected in this summary: calls, tokens and cost count each distinct request once with the figures it had when made (the ledgers' `full_*` totals count cached re-runs again; PaperQA2's first-run entry 621313 was re-saved from the cache twice, tripling its `full_*` figures); the saved `seconds` of that entry (6.9 s) is a cached re-save and its real wall time (177.2 s) is taken from `runs/external/paperqa/pilot.log`; GraphRAG local's query seconds are the sum of per-question seconds in `meta` (no query-run record), added to the recorded index time. PaperQA2 (whole-chunk) entries 301059 and 621313 were served entirely from the cache (all requests identical to the first run) and have no wall time of their own; its other entries' wall times understate a stand-alone run for the same reason.

Wall-clock time is not recorded per strategy in run omim100 (only per entry for all strategies together); for the comparison strategies, time is the sum of model-call seconds (`model_seconds`), which is also given for the systems. Systems ran with the adapter's concurrency cap of 3; the comparison strategies' generation is mostly one or a few calls.

Systems were asked six fixed section questions (PaperQA2, GraphRAG) and their answers concatenated; the comparison strategies write an OMIM-style entry in one pass. GraphRAG's answers include headings and framing lines as separate blocks; all text counts for (b) and the uncited share.
The claim-level audit without repair was run on the 4 entries both PaperQA2 and GraphRAG completed, not on every entry of each system, on every paragraph with mapped citations.

Judge noise: (b) credits facts anywhere in the draft and should not fall below (a), but it does on 5 system entries (paperqa/620029, paperqa/620249, graphrag/620029, graphrag_global/616326, graphrag_global/621313): the two are separate judge passes, so differences of a few points between them are within the judge's noise.

Extent of the comparison strategies' repair round on these 10 entries (paragraphs revised / deleted / in the final drafts): Direct reading 3 / 0 / 234; Agentic curator 2 / 0 / 240; Evidence graph 5 / 0 / 317; Case table first 1 / 0 / 291.
